fields.label: Rule Code
fields.description: Stable key, e.g. GATE-CSD, KILL-01, SCORE-SYSTEM

fields.label: Rule Class
fields.options:
Registration Gate
Disqualification Cause
Form Rule
Pricing Rule
Submission Rule
Scoring Rule
Buyer Quirk

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: Universal rules apply to every bid; Conditional rules apply only when the trigger condition matches the bid

fields.label: Regimes
fields.description: Comma-separated form-regime codes this rule is limited to (SBD, MBD, SOE, CIDB, RFQ). Blank = all regimes.

fields.label: Trigger Condition (JSON)
fields.description: For Conditional rules: a JSON object matched deterministically against the bid, e.g. {"estimated_value_over": 10000000} or a buyer match on the cached OCDS buyer name {"institution_matches": ["eskom", "transnet"]} (normalized substring, patterns are data). No AI is ever involved.

fields.label: Required Artifact Type
fields.description: When set, the pre-submission validator requires an unexpired Compliance Artifact of this type for the bidding user

fields.label: Freshness (days)
fields.description: How recent the supporting evidence must be at submission (e.g. 7, 30, 90, 180)

fields.label: Checklist Text
fields.description: The task text appended to a bid's checklist when this rule applies. Blank = the rule never generates a checklist row.

fields.label: Parameters (JSON)
fields.description: Structured constants for Scoring/Pricing rules, e.g. {"threshold_rand": 50000000, "straddle_band_pct": 10} or {"points_base": 80}

fields.label: Guide Reference
fields.description: Section anchor in tender/SA-Tender-Completion-Guide.md that this rule was lifted from
